name: Giant Ape
summary: A huge ape that pounds foes and hurls boulders.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ape makes two Fist attacks.

actions.name: Boulder Toss
actions.text: The ape hurls a boulder at a point it can see within 90 feet. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* {dc:str}, each creature in a 5-foot-radius {ref:glossary/sphere} centered on that point. *Failure:* {dmg:7d6:bludgeoning}. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/prone} condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Leap
bonusActions.text: The ape jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
